=======
LEGEND
=======

. = Background
P = Background and Player
* = Box
m = topmarker
q = topmarker and Box

================
COLLISIONLAYERS
================

Background
Player, Box
topmarker

======
RULES
======

[ > Player | Box ] -> [ > Player | > Box ]
[ moving Box | Box ] -> [ moving Box | moving Box ]
[ moving box topmarker ] -> [ moving box moving topmarker ]

==============
WINCONDITIONS
==============

all Box on Background

=======
LEVELS
=======
